title: On the Hilton-Zhao vertex-splitting conjecture
summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph with order $n$, maximum degree $Δ(G)$, and chromatic index $χ'(G)$, respectively. A graph $G$ is edge-chromatic critical if $χ'(H) \frac{n}{3}$, then $G^*$ is edge-chromatic critical. Recently, Cao, Chen, and Shan (Discrete Math. 2022) verified the conjecture for $Δ(G)\ge\frac{3n}{4}$. In this paper, we confirm the conjecture for $Δ(G) \ge\frac{2n-2}{3}$.
